motion.name: focus-trace
motion.purpose: The focus preview arc draws once to 72/100 and settles; it is an illustration, not an actual timer.

motion.name: dialog-open
motion.purpose: Native dialogs resolve from opacity .55, translateY(8px), scale(.985) and blur(2px).

motion.name: toast-confirmation
motion.purpose: The existing status check resolves from scale .65 and opacity .4 without changing the message's meaning.

motion.name: demonstration-visibility
motion.purpose: Apply finite desktop scene animations only when the stage intersects the viewport and the document is visible. Replace the keyed scene on goal changes; do not queue animations. Mobile thumbnails remain static.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable the home sequences, dialog/confirmation animations, press transforms, nonessential transitions and dialog backdrop blur; preserve content, direct actions and focus behavior.

narrative.northStar: A visible purpose, a direct action, an inspectable result.
narrative.overview:
The operating product is a clear, adult workspace: a graphite shell establishes location, cool white paper makes the current work readable, and restrained red identifies an action or active detail. Manrope and the established silver-blue Academy logo carry the identity. Preserve that logo as an asset; do not redraw or recolor it to match the action accent.

This direction supersedes the earlier blue-glass and mountain treatment within the operating core. The optional spatial map, immersive learning surfaces and independent editing modules retain their own functional needs. Designs generated for a customer's website or brand establish their own visual identity; the Academy shell palette does not constrain those deliverables.
keyCharacteristics: Clear location and a visible next action.
Quiet graphite framing around readable working paper.
Small red emphasis, with silver-blue identity and visible keyboard focus.
Bounded, interruptible motion that respects reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Red identifies a useful action or state; it does not flood the shell, replace the logo, or stand in for real progress.

rules.name: The Literal Label Rule
rules.body: Navigation names the visible destination. Controls name their actual action. Saving, generating, reviewing, approving and publishing remain visibly distinct states.

rules.name: The Bounded Motion Rule
rules.body: Motion explains a goal, acknowledges a press or distinguishes a temporary layer. Shell routes use an opacity-only arrival (180ms); ordinary color changes use (160ms). The home demonstrations run once and settle, with finite sequences lasting up to (1100ms). Direct actions remain usable throughout. Remove nonessential sequences, spatial movement and backdrop blur for reduced motion; never add continuous WebGL or background animation to entry.

dos: **Do** preserve the established silver-blue Academy logo.
**Do** use graphite framing, cool paper and restrained red within the operating core.
**Do** expose a direct next action and keep saved work reachable.
**Do** let each demonstration settle, stop it offscreen or in a hidden tab, and keep mobile thumbnails static.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus, readable contrast, responsive controls and reduced-motion support.
**Do** preserve the optional map and each editing module's independent behavior.
**Do** give generated customer websites and brands their own appropriate visual identity.
donts: **Don't** restore blue glass, mountain atmosphere, neon noise or a cluttered collage in the operating core.
**Don't** require the 3D map, a preview tap, an animation to finish or an extra confirmation before the selected entry task.
**Don't** obscure navigation, overload the first view, or duplicate supporting calls to action.
**Don't** use invented activity, testimonials, progress or completed AI work as visual content.
**Don't** equate a timer, preview, animation or selected map node with verified work, mastery or measured retention.
